ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is an Antarctic food web diagram. The krill labeled “Krill” is located in the lower middle of the image, and the Antarctic petrel labeled “Antarctic petrel” is in the right, slightly lower-middle position. There is an arrow from Krill to Antarctic petrel in the image, indicating that krill is one of the food sources of the Antarctic petrel. Reasoning: The question asks what will happen to petrel if krill increases. Because an increase in krill will provide more food for the Antarctic petrel that directly feeds on it, the number of Antarctic petrels will usually increase.
